title: Pahari Kinnauri language
description: Western Pahari language of Himachal Pradesh, India
extract: Pahari Kinnauri, or Kinnauri Pahari, is the only Indo-Aryan language among the nine languages spoken in the Kinnaur district of Himachal Pradesh. It is also called Oras Boli. It is spoken by the scheduled caste communities of Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh; the language used to be commonly known as 'Kinnauri tribal language', but this is now considered a derogatory term. It is not clear how distinct it is from other Western Pahari languages.
